text:
Situation: Bupivacaine hydrochloride has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2018-02-20 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds multiple presentations with 4 to 29.4 days on hand. Corvale General holds three lots with 17.3 to 21.7 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds two lots of the 2.5 mg/mL 10 mL vial with 18.5 and 21.1 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2018-02-20. Inspection 976095 at FEI 1925262 ended 2016-06-08 and was classified OAI. A Warning Letter was issued to FEI 1925262 on 2017-02-14. Inspection 1064827 at FEI 1925262 ended 2018-08-15 and was classified OAI, with its classification letter dated 2020-04-22. Inspection 1106244 at Pfizer Healthcare India (FEI 3008316085) ended 2019-09-06 and was classified OAI, with its classification letter dated 2020-05-25.

Our position: We use Hospira-labeled product from FEI 1021343 and FEI 1925262. Corvale East is the most constrained site. Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General have sufficient inventory to support limited transfers while maintaining at least two weeks of supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 19 units of the 2.5 mg/mL 10 mL vial from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East. Approval required: pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 120 units from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval required: pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Purchase bupivacaine hydrochloride from Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. Approval required: buyer.
4. Substitute Hospira, Inc. 2.5 mg/mL product via alternate NDC. Approval required: pharmacist.
5. Substitute Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 2.5 mg/mL product via alternate NDC. Approval required: pharmacist.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
